chunks.passage:
For Etihad Airways Economy travel to or from destinations outside the USA and Canada, including Delhi to Abu Dhabi, the published cabin bag allowance is one bag up to 7 kg for Basic, Value, Comfort, and Deluxe fares.
For the same Economy fares, published checked baggage allowances are: Basic — fees apply (no included checked allowance); Value — 25 kg; Comfort — 30 kg; Deluxe — 40 kg.
The allowance depends on the booked fare type. Check the ticket or booking for the exact fare type and any applicable Etihad Guest benefits.
